question: Could you tell me the first names of customers who spent less than $1 on albums by the best-selling artist, along with the amounts they spent?
sql:
-- Verify: check total count and ensure we have all customers
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS amount_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) < 1
ORDER BY amount_spent, c.FirstName;

The tracks table serves as the central entity for media content, linking to albums, genres, and media types through AlbumId, GenreId, and MediaTypeId. Artists are linked to albums via ArtistId, and employees support customers via SupportRepId. Playlists and their contents are managed through the playlists and playlist_track table, with playlist_track acting as a junction table linking playlists to tracks.

    SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM artists a
JOIN albums al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId

FROM artists a

JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
